item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 17/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry continental airstream, it will be persistently very hot and mainly fine over southern China in the next couple of days, and winds will be weak. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to bring a few showers to the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nanmadol will move towards the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands and Kyushu of Japan in the next couple of days.
